lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots on the mid-lateral flank. Three distinct vertical columns are discernible, with three to four nodes per column visible in the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid across the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature with a high-contrast luminance gradient (light on top, dark on bottom) runs along the upper third of the lateral body.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of high-luminance spots is localized on the basal and central regions of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe truncation and jagged, irregular edges on the top and trailing side of the first dorsal fin indicating significant tissue loss. Light-colored superficial marks are present on the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Two remoras are attached/swimming near the ventral silhouette; distinct spot patterning is present on the caudal fin lobes.
